name: Trial Bikes
hook: Gas, lean, flip. Don't land on your head.
how: Race dirt bikes over hills, jumps and steps while everyone else rides beside you as a ghost. Lean to land on both wheels: a flip takes a second off your time, a crash sends you back to the last checkpoint.
controls: Up to gas, Down to brake, Left/Right to lean, R for the checkpoint, or on-screen buttons
uses: The best time on each of the three tracks.
The host's browser starts each race, picks the track and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots ride, flip and sometimes crash, until enough people join.
Every bike rides the same track for everyone at once, as see-through ghosts.
ideas: Add a loop-the-loop on the first track
Add a nitro button that refills at each checkpoint
Make it a snowmobile race in the mountains
